articles.title: Don’t Print the Label for That Bowl Yet
articles.summary: With one day left before the open house, the shallow bowl has lost its paper label. A-Cheng drafts the kiln number, then notices another cup before printing.
articles.summaryZh: 开放日只剩一天，浅口碗的纸标签掉了。阿澄把窑号填进草稿，准备打印时，又看见另一只杯子。
storyParagraphs: With one day left before the pottery studio’s open house, A-Cheng is replacing a shallow bowl’s label. The paper label has fallen off, and a square chalk mark shows on the base. She remembers batch 47 coming from kiln 2 and all its display pieces carrying this “to be photographed” mark. She enters kiln 2 in the draft but leaves it in the “to be confirmed” column. The other cards are already trimmed; she tucks this one under the keyboard to check before printing it with the rest.

She goes to the packing table for the photographs. A display test cup there has the same square mark on its base, but its intact label says kiln 1. The packing checklist marks every batch-47 display piece as “marked,” with the test cup listed on a separate row. A-Cheng reads the small print above the list: the square only means awaiting photography. She turns the cup over beside the bowl. The marks on their bases are identical.

A-Cheng writes her proposed grounds on a note: All display pieces in batch 47 and fired in kiln 2 have square marks; this bowl has a square mark; therefore this bowl belongs to batch 47 and came from kiln 2. She moves the note beside the test cup and replaces both instances of “this bowl” with “this cup.” The first two lines still fit, but the last conflicts with the cup’s kiln 1 label. She crosses the kiln number out of the draft and leaves the note on the packing table.

She wipes the dust from the bowl’s base with a damp cloth, revealing an engraved code: K47-18. The batch list places it under 47, and the firing sheet records “All pieces in batch 47 fired in kiln 2.” On a new note A-Cheng writes three lines: All pieces in batch 47 were fired in kiln 2; K47-18 belongs to batch 47; therefore K47-18 was fired in kiln 2. The old note stays beside the cup; the new one goes beside the bowl.

A-Cheng checks the 47 on the firing sheet against the 41 in the neighboring row, then holds the list beside the bowl to compare K47-18 character by character. Before printing, she also finds the firing-day photograph on the packing-table computer. The shallow bowl is among the kiln 2 pieces. She writes the photograph’s filename on the back of the new note and refills the label. The square-mark note beside the test cup still has a line struck through its conclusion.

Before the open house, the reprinted card says only “K47-18 / Batch 47 / Kiln 2.” The square chalk mark is not entered in the source field. At the packing table, the kiln 1 test cup still carries the same square mark, sitting separately from the shallow bowl whose kiln has now been confirmed.
storyParagraphsZh: 陶艺工作室开放日只剩一天，阿澄在给一只浅口碗补说明卡。纸标签掉了，碗底露着方形粉笔印。她记得批次47来自2号窑，那批待展作品都画过这种“待拍照”印，便先把2号窑填进草稿，留在“待确认”栏。旁边的卡片已经裁好，她把这张单独压在键盘下，准备查完再一起打印。
她去包装台找照片，桌上还有一只待展测试杯，底部也画着方形印，完整标签却写着1号窑。包装清单把批次47的待展作品全部勾成“已标记”，测试杯另列一行。阿澄再看清单上方的小字：方形印只管待拍照。她把杯子翻过来放在碗旁，两只底上的印一模一样。
阿澄把草稿的依据写在便签上：批次47且在2号窑烧成的待展作品都有方形印；这只碗有方形印；所以这只碗属于批次47、来自2号窑。她把便签挪到测试杯旁，把两处“这只碗”换成“这只杯”。前两行照样对得上，最后一行却与杯上的1号窑标签冲突。她划掉草稿里的窑号，把便签留在包装台。
她拿湿布擦掉碗底的粉尘，一串刻码慢慢露出来：K47-18。批次清单把它列在47号下，烧成表又记着“批次47的所有作品均在2号窑烧成”。阿澄在新便签上写了三行：批次47的所有作品都在2号窑烧成；K47-18属于批次47；所以K47-18在2号窑烧成。旧便签仍留在杯旁，新便签放到碗边。
阿澄先把烧成表的47和旁边一行的41逐个对清，再拿着清单核碗底的K47-18。打印前，包装台电脑里的出窑照片也找到了，浅口碗就在2号窑那批作品中。她把照片文件名记到新便签背面，重新填好说明卡；测试杯旁那张方形印便签，最后一行还留着一道划痕。
开放日前，重新打印的小卡只写“K47-18／批次47／2号窑”。方形粉笔印没有被写进来源栏；包装台那只1号窑测试杯仍带着同样的方形印，和已经确认窑号的浅口碗分开放在两处。
articles.overall: Deductive validity asks whether the conclusion must be true whenever all the premises are true. Soundness additionally requires premises that are actually true. A conclusion happening to be correct does not establish the validity of the original argument.
articles.overallZh: 演绎有效性检查前提全真时结论是否必然为真；可靠性（健全性）还要求实际前提全真。结论碰巧正确，不能反过来证明原推理有效。
explanationParagraphs: A deductive argument is valid when there is no possible case in which all its premises are true and its conclusion false. The square-mark argument can be tested with the kiln 1 cup: the universal premise can remain true and the cup does have a square mark, while the conclusion that the cup is in batch 47 and from kiln 2 is false.

A sound argument must also have premises that are actually true. The batch 47 argument has a valid form; checking 47 versus 41 and verifying K47-18 are factual checks. A later photograph confirming the conclusion still cannot rescue the earlier invalid form.
explanationParagraphsZh: 演绎有效指不存在“前提全真而结论为假”的情况。方形印三行推理可用1号窑测试杯构造反例：全称前提仍可真，杯子有印也真，但“杯子属批次47且来自2号窑”为假。
可靠（健全）论证还要求前提实际全真。批次47推理形式有效，47/41与K47-18核对属于事实检查；后来照片确认结论，也不能挽救先前无效形式。

module.intro: A definite conclusion must pass both a test of logical form and a separate check of real-world premises; guessing the right answer does not prove that the original reasoning was valid.
module.diagramTitle: From a Square-Mark Guess to the Batch 47 Argument
diagramSteps: Turn the square-mark intuition into a universal three-line argument
Find an object for which the premises can be true and the conclusion false
Use batch 47 and K47-18 to construct a valid form
Check the batch list and firing sheet as factual premises
Make the final label only from verified grounds
diagramStepNotes: All display pieces in batch 47 and from kiln 2 have square marks; the object has a square mark; therefore the object belongs to that batch and kiln.
The kiln 1 display test cup also has a mark: the universal premise can still be true, the second premise is true, and the conclusion is false.
All batch 47 pieces were fired in kiln 2; K47-18 belongs to batch 47; therefore K47-18 was fired in kiln 2.
Checking 47 versus 41 and K47-18 against the original records is factual verification.
The final card keeps only the engraved code, batch, and kiln.
mapping: Square “to be photographed” mark → useful for a guess but not enough to determine kiln uniquely.
Kiln 1 test cup → counterexample object for the invalid form.
Batch list + firing sheet → sources for the two real-world premises in the valid argument.
Firing-day photograph → extra confirmation of the conclusion without changing the validity judgment.
module.boundary: Validity evaluates only the formal relationship between premises and conclusion; it does not guarantee that the premises are true. Soundness requires both validity and true premises. An invalid argument can accidentally reach a true conclusion, while a valid argument with a false premise is still unsound. This discussion concerns deductive arguments, not all inductive or probabilistic reasoning.
module.reflection: If a conclusion that began as a reasonable guess is later confirmed as true, how would you use a counterexample to test the original form and then separately verify the real-world premises of the new argument?

moduleZh.intro: 确定性结论需要分别通过形式检验和现实前提核查；猜中结论不能反过来证明原推理有效。
moduleZh.diagramTitle: 从方形印猜测到批次47论证
diagramSteps: 把方形印直觉写成全称三行推理
寻找前提全真而结论假的对象
改用批次47与K47-18建立有效形式
分别核对清单与烧成表现实前提
用已核对依据制作最终标签
diagramStepNotes: 批次47且2号窑的待展作品都有方形印；对象有印；故对象属该批次且窑。
1号窑待展测试杯也有印：全称前提可真、第二前提真、结论假。
所有批次47作品在2号窑；K47-18属批次47；故K47-18在2号窑。
检查47/41及K47-18是否与原始记录一致，这是事实核查。
最终卡只保留刻码、批次和窑号。
mapping: 方形待拍照印 → 可用于猜测，但不能唯一确定窑号。
1号窑测试杯 → 无效形式的反例对象。
批次清单＋烧成表 → 有效推理的两个现实前提来源。
出窑照片 → 额外确认结论，不改变形式判定。
moduleZh.boundary: 有效性只评价前提与结论的形式关系，不保证前提真实；可靠性要求有效且前提全真。无效推理可能偶然得到真结论，有效推理若含假前提也不可靠。这里讨论的是演绎论证，不涵盖所有归纳或概率推理。
moduleZh.reflection: 如果一个最初只是合理猜测的结论后来证实为真，你会怎样构造反例检查原推理形式，再另外核查新论证的现实前提？

references.use: Supports defining sound arguments as valid arguments with true premises and using counterexamples to test deductive form.
